verdict.rationale: gstack documents a /learn skill that can export what it has learned across sessions, and its learnings are stored locally as JSONL under ~/.gstack/projects/{slug}/learnings.jsonl, which is an open, portable format. Nothing shows that all user data (such as per-site domain skills or other session state) can be exported comprehensively, and no leave or migration path is documented. Missing for 10: evidence of complete export covering all data types, documented export formats beyond learnings, an explicit offboarding or migration story, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
